'''Thull's Shroud''' was a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] about which the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region surrounded. It was named for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] hero and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorer [[Thull Vandron]].
